plantedBugs.description: SELECT * loads entire candidates table into memory. For 100k candidates this OOMs. Should stream rows or paginate.
No backpressure handling — c.body may buffer the entire CSV in memory before sending. Should use ReadableStream.
No auth check — any unauthenticated user can export all candidate data. GDPR breach risk.
Missing CSV header row — exported file has no column names.
